title: Testing Exclusion and Shape Restrictions in Potential Outcomes Models
abstract: arXiv:2512.20851v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Exclusion and shape restrictions play a central role in defining causal effects and interpreting estimates in potential outcomes models. To date, the testable implications of such restrictions have been studied on a case-by-case basis in a limited set of models. In this paper, we develop a general framework for characterizing sharp testable implications of general support restrictions on the potential response functions, based on a novel graph-based representation of the model. The framework provides a unified and constructive method for deriving all observable implications of the modeling assumptions. We illustrate the approach in several popular settings, including instrumental variables, treatment selection, mediation, and interference. As an empirical application, we revisit the US Lung Health Study and test for the presence of spillovers between spouses, specification of exposure maps, and persistence of treatment effects over t

translated_title: 潜在结果模型中排除性限制与形状限制的检验
translated_abstract: 排除性限制和形状限制在潜在结果模型中对于定义因果效应和解释估计结果起着核心作用。迄今为止，这类限制的可检验含义仅在有限的模型中被逐案研究。本文基于一种新颖的基于图的模型表示方法，开发了一个一般性框架，用于刻画潜在响应函数上一般支撑限制的尖锐可检验含义。该框架为推导建模假设的所有可观测含义提供了统一且具有建设性的方法。我们在多个流行的研究设定中展示了该方法，包括工具变量、处理选择、中介效应和干扰效应。作为实证应用，我们重新审视了美国肺部健康研究，检验了配偶之间的溢出效应、暴露映射的设定以及处理效应的持续性。
tldr: 本文基于新颖的图表示方法开发了一个一般性框架，统一刻画了潜在结果模型中支撑限制的所有尖锐可检验含义，并应用于工具变量、处理选择、中介与干扰等设定以及美国肺部健康研究的实证检验。
